cues.en: A big part of why recommender systems are as much art as they are science, is that it's difficult to measure how good they are.
cues.zh: 推薦系統既像藝術，也像科學，很大的原因是它的好壞很難衡量。

cues.en: There's a certain aesthetic quality to the results they give you, and it's hard to say whether a person considers the recommendation to be good or not.
cues.zh: 推薦結果有某種美感上的品質，很難判定某個人是否認為這是好的推薦。

cues.en: Especially if you're developing your algorithms offline.
cues.zh: 尤其是在離線開發演算法時。

cues.en: People have come up with a lot of different ways to measure the quality of a recommender system and often, different measurements can be at odds with each other.
cues.zh: 人們提出許多不同方式，衡量推薦系統品質，而且不同衡量方式往往彼此衝突。

cues.en: But let's go through the more popular metrics for recommender systems, as they all have their own uses.
cues.zh: 但還是來介紹較常用的推薦系統指標，它們各有用途。

cues.en: First, let's talk about the methodology for testing recommender systems offline.
cues.zh: 首先，談談離線測試推薦系統的方法。

cues.en: If you've done machine learning before, you're probably familiar with the concept of train/test splits.
cues.zh: 如果以前做過機器學習，應該熟悉訓練／測試分割的概念。

cues.en: A recommender system is a machine learning system.
cues.zh: 推薦系統也是機器學習系統。

cues.en: You train it using prior user behavior, and then use it to make predictions about items new users might like.
cues.zh: 你用過去的使用者行為訓練它，再用它預測新使用者可能喜歡哪些項目。

cues.en: So on paper at least, you can evaluate a recommender system just like any other machine learning system.
cues.zh: 因此，至少理論上，可以像評估其他機器學習系統一樣，評估推薦系統。

cues.en: Here's how it works: You measure your recommender system's ability to predict how people rated things in the past.
cues.zh: 做法是：衡量推薦系統預測人們過去評分的能力。

cues.en: But to keep it honest, you start by splitting up your ratings data into a training set, and a testing set.
cues.zh: 但為了公平，先把評分資料分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: Usually the training set is bigger, say 80 or 90 percent of all of your data, and you randomly assign ratings into one or the other.
cues.zh: 通常訓練集比較大，例如全部資料的 80% 或 90%，並將評分隨機分到其中一組。

cues.en: So you train your recommender system using only the training data.
cues.zh: 接著，只用訓練資料訓練推薦系統。

cues.en: This is where it learns the relationships it needs between items or between users.
cues.zh: 這時它會學習所需的項目間或使用者間關係。

cues.en: Once it's trained, you can ask it to make predictions about how a new user might rate some item they've never seen before.
cues.zh: 訓練完成後，就能要求它預測新使用者，可能會給未曾看過的某個項目多少分。

cues.en: So to measure how well it does, we take the data we reserved for testing.
cues.zh: 要衡量表現，就拿出先前保留的測試資料。

cues.en: These are ratings that our recommender system has never seen before.
cues.zh: 這些評分是推薦系統從來沒看過的。

cues.en: So that keeps it from cheating.
cues.zh: 因此可以防止它作弊。

cues.en: Let's say one rating in our test set says that the user actually rated the movie "Up" five stars.
cues.zh: 假設測試集中有一筆評分，顯示使用者實際給電影《天外奇蹟》五顆星。

cues.en: We just ask the recommender system how it thinks this user would rate "Up" without telling it the answer.
cues.zh: 我們不告訴推薦系統答案，只問它認為這位使用者會給《天外奇蹟》幾顆星。

cues.en: And then we can measure how close it came to the real rating.
cues.zh: 接著就能衡量預測與真實評分有多接近。

cues.en: If you do this over enough people, you can end up with a meaningful number that tells you how good your recommender system is at recommending things, or more specifically, recommending things
cues.zh: 對足夠多的人這樣做，就能得到有意義的數字，告訴你推薦系統推薦東西的能力有多好；更精確地說，是推薦

cues.en: people already watched and rated.
cues.zh: 人們已經看過並評分的東西的能力。

cues.en: That's really all you can do, if you can't test things out in an online system.
cues.zh: 如果無法在線上系統測試，基本上就只能這麼做。

cues.en: If you really want to get fancy, it's possible to improve on a single train/test split by using a technique called k-fold cross validation.
cues.zh: 如果真的想更講究，可以用稱為 k 折交叉驗證的技術，改善單一次訓練／測試分割。

cues.en: It's the same idea as train/test, but instead of a single training set, we create many randomly assigned training sets.
cues.zh: 概念與訓練／測試相同，但不是只有一個訓練集，而是建立多個隨機分配的訓練集。

cues.en: Each individual training set, or fold, is used to train your recommender system independently, and then we measure the accuracy of the resulting systems against your test set.
cues.zh: 每個訓練集，也就是每一折，都分別訓練推薦系統，再用測試集衡量所產生系統的準確程度。

cues.en: So we end up with a score of how accurately each fold ends up predicting user ratings, and we can average them together.
cues.zh: 因此，每一折都會得到預測使用者評分的準確分數，再把這些分數取平均。

cues.en: This obviously takes a lot more computing power to do, but the advantage is that you don't end up over-fitting to a single training set.
cues.zh: 這顯然需要更多運算能力，但好處是，不會只對單一訓練集過度擬合。

cues.en: If your training data is small, you run the risk of optimizing for the ratings that are specifically in your training set instead of the test set.
cues.zh: 如果訓練資料很少，可能會只針對訓練集裡的特定評分進行最佳化，而不是測試集。

cues.en: So k-fold cross-validation provides some insurance against that, and insures that you create a recommender system that works for any set of ratings, not just the ones in the training set
cues.zh: 因此 k 折交叉驗證能降低這個風險，確保建立的推薦系統適用於任何一組評分，而不只是

cues.en: that you happen to choose.
cues.zh: 你碰巧選到的訓練集評分。

cues.en: To reiterate, train/test and k-fold cross-validation are ways to measure the accuracy of your recommender system.
cues.zh: 再次強調，訓練／測試與 k 折交叉驗證，是衡量推薦系統準確程度的方法。

cues.en: That is, how accurately you can predict how users rated movies they have already seen and provided a rating for.
cues.zh: 也就是你預測使用者對已看過、並提供評分的電影評價，有多準確。

cues.en: But that's an important point.
cues.zh: 但這一點非常重要。

cues.en: By using train/test, all we can do is test our ability to predict how people rated movies they already saw.
cues.zh: 使用訓練／測試時，只能測試預測人們對已看過電影評分的能力。

cues.en: That's not the point of a recommender system.
cues.zh: 這不是推薦系統的目的。

cues.en: We want to recommend new things to people that they haven't seen, but find interesting.
cues.zh: 我們想向人們推薦沒看過、卻會感興趣的新東西。

cues.en: However, that's fundamentally impossible to test offline.
cues.zh: 然而，這件事根本無法離線測試。

cues.en: So researchers who can't just test out new algorithms on real people, on Netflix or Amazon, or whatever, have to make do with approaches like this.
cues.zh: 因此，無法直接在 Netflix、Amazon 等平台，拿真實使用者測試新演算法的研究者，只能退而求其次，使用這類方法。

cues.en: We haven't talked about how to actually come up with an accuracy metric when testing our recommender system, so let's cover a couple of different ways to do it.
cues.zh: 我們還沒談測試推薦系統時，如何實際計算準確程度指標，接著來介紹幾種方式。
